prompt: Create a complete production 2D isometric RPG animation atlas STRICTLY based on the attached original character portrait. Preserve its exact design, silhouette, proportions, palette, face, clothing, equipment and limb anatomy. Same detailed small painted game-sprite style and elevated isometric viewpoint. Fully transparent RGBA background, no scenery, captions, grids or cast shadows. EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and THIRTEEN ROWS = 104 separate whole articulated poses. Every complete character including wings and extended limbs must be SMALL, occupying at most 50 percent of the width and height of its cell. Large empty gutters, at least 25 pixels fully transparent on all sides of each pose and outer border. Never touch neighbors or clip body parts. Exact column direction order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE. E is a strict right profile, SE front-right, S DIRECTLY FRONT facing the viewer, SW front-left, W strict left profile, NW back-left, N FULL BACK with no face visible, NE back-right. Do not reuse three-quarter front facing for side or rear directions. Keep each column's compass in every action. Rows exactly: 1 neutral idle; 2 visibly distinct breathing idle; 3 first walking/movement step; 4 passing movement phase; 5 opposite movement step; 6 attack windup; 7 attack CONTACT toward the facing direction; 8 attack recovery; 9 hit recoil; 10 hit recovery; 11 death buckling/falling begins; 12 falling close to ground; 13 final flat collapsed recognizable body, limbs connected. All 104 poses must be actually articulated and distinct, never repeated or merely translated. Constant whole-body scale throughout. Preserve this original adult SUCCUBUS: pale lavender skin, pale silver/white head/hair, close-fitting violet and black fantasy costume, dark high boots, and the exact pair of small angular black bat wings. Wings attached to upper back. Do not add horns, a tail, a staff, swords, a shield or new costume parts. No nudity or sexual pose: neutral combat monster stance like the reference. Grounded biped walking with original booted legs, bat wings balanced behind. Magic attack draws original hands close to body then thrusts a hand out IN ITS FACING DIRECTION then recovers; only subtle violet light attached to the hand, no separate orbs, projectiles or clouds. Death wings fold closely over/alongside the collapsed connected body. Keep the original slender silhouette and exact wing shape.
